findings.evidence: Nextgen path runs `bootstrapSchemas` on every start before bootstrap-version check: pkg/session/session.go:3543. `bootstrapSchemas` creates DBs/tables via meta by fixed IDs: pkg/session/bootstrap.go:1215, pkg/session/session.go:3409. Meta existence checks are ID-only (no name check): pkg/meta/meta.go:825, pkg/meta/meta.go:676, pkg/meta/meta.go:721. Infoschema explicitly overwrites by schema name if duplicates exist: pkg/infoschema/infoschema.go:455.
findings.fix: In nextgen bootstrap, detect pre-existing system schemas/tables by *name* and enforce ID consistency: if `mysql`/`sys` exists with a different ID, fail fast with a clear incompatibility error (or implement an explicit migration), rather than creating another DB/table entry. Similarly, when creating system tables, check for existing table name in the target DB and error if name exists with mismatched ID.
findings.impact: Compatibility/data-consistency risk for nextgen upgrades: if a store already has `mysql`/`sys` (and mysql system tables) created with non-reserved IDs (e.g., from pre-change nextgen bootstraps or manual operations), this code can create duplicate schemas/tables with the same names but new reserved IDs. Because infoschema overwrites by name, TiDB may start using the newly created (empty) system tables, effectively losing existing privilege/global-var/stats state or producing inconsistent metadata.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked upstream/master@3b531d4e3d99cb988bebccb8f63a96afff0ec6cd: `CreateSysDatabaseByIDIfNotExists` still checks existence by ID only; `bootstrapSchemas` still calls it (no name/ID mismatch guard).
findings.verify: Create a store where `mysql` DB exists under a non-reserved ID (or any existing system table name exists with a different ID), then run nextgen bootstrap flow and inspect meta/infoschema: ensure bootstrap errors out (after fix) instead of creating a second `mysql`/system-table set; verify existing privilege/global-vars/stats remain intact.
findings.what: Nextgen bootstrap can create duplicate system schemas/tables (same names, different IDs) on an already-initialized store, because nextgen bootstrap uses fixed reserved IDs but meta create paths only check existence by ID (not by name), and infoschema overwrites duplicates by name.

subject: bootstrap: use reserved ID for system schemas/tables in nextgen (#62570)
summary: Introduces nextgen-only bootstrapping that creates `mysql`/`sys` schemas and mysql system tables directly via meta KV using reserved IDs, tracked by a new NextGen boot table version. Classic kernel keeps DDL-based creation. Also tweaks bootstrap region-splitting behavior and uses a static expr context (SQLMode None) when building table infos for meta-created tables; renames `CheckDDLTableVersion` to `GetDDLTableVersion`.
